question: What paradoxical condition affects even the wise at the tip of nectar?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar
There is contact with the essence of juice
Even a wise person is described as burning
inference: Even the wise may experience a burning condition at the tip of nectar despite its essence.
uncertainties: The imagery of nectar and burning is doctrinally compressed.
plain_english: Even the wise person may burn at the tip of nectar, touched by the essence of its juice.
